mapper.select: SELECT growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", level_no AS "levelNo", level_name AS "levelName", min_exp AS "minExp", max_exp AS "maxExp", tree_image_path AS "treeImagePath" FROM growth_levels ORDER BY level_no ASC

SELECT t.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", t.growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", g.level_no AS "levelNo", g.level_name AS "levelName", t.total_exp AS "totalExp", g.tree_image_path AS "treeImagePath" FROM growth_tree t JOIN growth_levels g ON t.growth_level_id = g.growth_level_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_tree(workspace_growth_id, workspace_id, month, growth_level_id, total_exp, updated_at) VALUES(SEQ_WORKSPACE_GROWTH.NEXTVAL, #{workspaceId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM'), (SELECT growth_level_id FROM growth_levels WHERE min_exp <=0 AND (max_exp IS NULL OR max_exp >=0) ), 0, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_GROWTH_EXP_LOGS.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO growth_exp_logs( exp_log_id, workspace_id, member_id, notice_id, exp, action_type, earned_at, invite_key, sub_task_id, daily_report_id, team_report_id) VALUES(#{expLogId}, #{workspaceId}, #{memberId}, #{noticeId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{exp}, #{actionType}, SYSDATE, #{inviteKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subTaskId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dailyReportId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{teamReportId, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id AS "workspaceId", growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", total_exp AS "totalExp" FROM growth_tree WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_tree SET total_exp = #{totalExp}, growth_level_id = #{growthLevelId}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id AS "workspaceId" FROM workspace_invites wi WHERE wi.accepted_member_id = #{memberId} AND wi.invite_key = #{inviteKey} AND wi.status = 0 AND wi.invite_status = 1 AND wi.accepted IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members wm WHERE wm.workspace_id = wi.workspace_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.left IS NULL )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_tasks st JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = st.project_id AND t.task_id = st.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id WHERE st.sub_task_id = #{subTaskId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND st.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_reports dr JOIN sub_tasks st ON st.sub_task_id = dr.sub_task_id JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = st.project_id AND t.task_id = st.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id WHERE dr.daily_report_id = #{dailyReportId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND st.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND dr.deleted IS NULL

SELECT p.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", pm.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId" FROM sub_tasks st JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = st.project_id AND t.task_id = st.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_member_id = st.project_member_id AND pm.project_id = p.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE st.sub_task_id = #{subTaskId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.left IS NULL AND st.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd WHERE wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' )

SELECT p.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", pm.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId" FROM daily_reports dr JOIN sub_tasks st ON st.sub_task_id = dr.sub_task_id JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = st.project_id AND t.task_id = st.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_member_id = st.project_member_id AND pm.project_id = p.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE dr.daily_report_id = #{dailyReportId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.left IS NULL AND st.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND dr.deleted IS NULL AND dr.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews rr WHERE rr.daily_report_id = dr.daily_report_id AND (rr.viewed IS NOT NULL OR rr.reviewed IS NOT NULL) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd WHERE wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = tr.project_id AND t.task_id = tr.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id WHERE tr.team_report_id = #{teamReportId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND pm.project_member_id = tr.project_member_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.left IS NULL )

SELECT tr.team_report_id AS "teamReportId", p.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", tr.project_member_id AS "authorProjectMemberId" FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = tr.project_id AND t.task_id = tr.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = tr.project_id WHERE tr.team_report_id = #{teamReportId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd WHERE wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND pm.project_member_id = tr.project_member_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.left IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews rr WHERE rr.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND rr.category = 2 AND(rr.viewed IS NOT NULL OR rr.reviewed IS NOT NULL OR rr.status IN (1, 2)) )

SELECT tr.team_report_id AS "teamReportId", p.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", tr.project_member_id AS "authorProjectMemberId" FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = tr.project_id AND t.task_id = tr.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = tr.project_id WHERE tr.team_report_id = #{teamReportId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd WHERE wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND pm.project_member_id = tr.project_member_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.left IS NULL )

SELECT p.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", pm.role AS "reviewerRole" FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = tr.project_id AND t.task_id = tr.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = tr.project_id JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_member_id = rr.project_member_id AND pm.project_id = p.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE tr.team_report_id = #{teamReportId} AND rr.report_id = #{reviewId} AND rr.category = 2 AND rr.status = 1 AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND pm.project_member_id != tr.project_member_id AND pm.role IN (70, 50) AND pm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL
